card.name: Historical narrative past-tense setting words
card.fires_on: Words in historical accounts that sit in a past-tense setting, such as 'then', 'at the time', or commas and 'and' inside a description of how things originally were. It also fires on a digit starting an old year.

modes.label: Past-time markers
modes.description: Words like 'then' or 'time' that place a fact in an earlier era.
modes.example: a suburb<< then>> on the northern edge of London, though

modes.label: Early-history description
modes.description: Commas, 'and', or nouns within sentences describing the original state of a town, mill, or lodge.
modes.example: The original aldermen numbered 15, from 5 districts,<< and>> received no salary.

modes.label: Old dates and wartime names
modes.description: The start of a 19th-century year or a word in a Civil War-era passage.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words meaning 'until today' or 'early', which fit a continuing or present-day framing.
card.plain: It marks text that describes how things were in the past, in historical stories.
